DryDriver.docs: Primary adapter driver for the `dry` command family. IN-14/AC-20 (superseding this track's own prior IN-13 `reference` declaration): DryDriver's public `new` constructor holds four injected services (four params total): `service` backs only dry_fix_local (OS-08, unchanged); `write_service` / `results_service` / `check_approved_service` back the three IN-14-migrated commands, each invoked directly by the corresponding `handle` arm. `dry_check_approved` performs a pure invoke+render: it calls `check_approved_service.dry_check_approved` and renders the resulting `DryCheckApprovedOutcome` into a `CommandOutcome`, with no side-effecting I/O of its own -- wall-clock timing measurement and `GateEval` telemetry emission for this call live in the bin layer (`apps/cli/src/commands/dry.rs::execute_dry_check_approved`), mirroring `execute_verify_with_telemetry`'s bin-level pattern (Port abstraction was tried and retracted across two earlier IN-14 drafts: first a `check_approved_telemetry: Arc<dyn DryCheckApprovedTelemetryPort>` field on this struct, and before that an infrastructure-hosted `TimedGateEvalDryCheckApprovedService` decorator implementing the primary port -- both added a layer-boundary violation or unwarranted port indirection at this boundary; neither exists anymore). `handle` gains a new private render helper for the Results variant (DryResultsOutcome -> CommandOutcome, reproducing the former per-record `lines.push(format!(...))` text byte-for-byte per CN-07/AC-19); the Write / CheckApproved render helpers (render_dry_write_outcome / render_dry_check_approved_outcome) are unchanged from IN-13. `handle`'s own public signature (`&self, input: DryInput) -> CommandOutcome`) is unchanged.

PrInput.docs: Typed input for the `pr` command family. Pre-existing type (baseline: Ensure.base and WaitAndMerge.method were plain String); this track (IN-03/AC-09) changes Ensure.base and WaitAndMerge.method to Option<String> so PrDriver forwards the caller's none-means-default intent through to the composition root, which resolves merge_target / merge_method from the active track's branch_strategy_snapshot when the CLI flag is omitted -- mirroring the cli-layer EnsurePrArgs/WaitAndMergeArgs precedent already declared in cli-types.json. Role is Dto (not PrimaryAdapter): this enum is a plain input DTO consumed by PrDriver::handle, not itself the driving adapter (see R1: cli/cli_driver clap args and input DTOs use the Dto role; same role correction already applied to TrackInput in this catalogue). R9 primitive justification: base/method stay raw Option<String> because cli_driver may_depend_on=[usecase] only -- Option<domain::branch_strategy::MergeMethod> (and an equivalent branch-name value object) are architecturally impossible to name in this layer; both concepts are already modelled at the domain layer (BranchStrategySnapshot.merge_target as NonEmptyString, .merge_method as MergeMethod, both validated) and the raw-string-to-domain-type conversion happens downstream in cli_composition, which does depend on domain. The remaining fields (track_id, pr, interval, timeout, trigger_timestamp, resume) are unchanged by this track: track_id carries the same cli_driver-cannot-depend-on-domain rationale as TrackInput.track_id in this catalogue; pr/interval/timeout/trigger_timestamp/resume are opaque technical values (external PR identifier, poll timing knobs, an ISO-8601 timestamp echo, and a boolean resume flag) with no finite-value domain concept to model.

TrackInput.docs: Typed input for the track command family. SwitchBase is new in this track (IN-05): switches to the base branch read from the active track's branch_strategy_snapshot. FixpointResolve is new in this track (IN-12): fields mirror usecase::fixpoint_resolve_driver::FixpointResolveDriverInput field-for-field. Role corrected from PrimaryAdapter to Dto: this enum is a plain input DTO consumed by TrackDriver::handle, not itself the driving adapter (see R1: cli/cli_driver clap args and input DTOs use the Dto role).

TrackDriver.docs: Primary adapter driver for the `track` command family. Holds injected TrackService (for the existing wide-facade subcommands) and, new in this track (IN-12/AC-17), an injected FixpointResolveDriverService used only by the FixpointResolve variant: `handle` invokes it and renders FixpointResolveDriverOutcome into CommandOutcome directly in this layer, instead of TrackCompositionRoot invoking FixpointResolveService and formatting the result itself.
